basic_info.description: First Time on the Market in Over 50 Years!  Discover timeless magic of this 1935-built single-family home, located on a highly desirable block on 17th Ave. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, w/an additional bonus rm downstairs and a coveted 2-car garage w/plenty of storage space as well as an area for a workshop. This home is filled w/original San Francisco character & classic architectural details. Timeless San Francisco Appeal: Original details throughout, including gorgeous hardwood floors, high ceilings, and a decorative mural above the fireplace mantel. Spacious Living Rm: High ceilings, gorgeous hard wood floors, decorative molding, elegant ornamental fireplace complete w/one of a kind mural. Natural light floods into the room in the afternoon and a view of the Ocean adds the final touch. Elegant Dining Rm: boasts of stunning hardwood wood floors a beam molding, while sunshine streams in from the center patio. The ideal gathering space for family & friends this holiday. Breakfast Rm: Built-in cabinets operate as an extension of the kitchen. The updated kitchen w/new counter tops giving the whole floor a bright and airy layout. Conveniently located near popular restaurants, shops & more, this home is the perfect blend of San Francisco history & modern-day convenience.
